This page is for visitors and English-speaking residents of Normandy. The rest of the website is in French. This page is a draft that the regional centres still have to review.

::: {.quand-consulter titre="Emergency"}
- **Medical emergency: call 15** (the French ambulance service, SAMU) **or 112** (the European emergency number, which also works from any mobile phone). Like 999 in the UK.
- **Poisoning, or too much of a medicine: call the Angers poison centre on [02 41 48 21 21](tel:+33241482121)**, 24 hours a day. It covers Normandy.
:::

## I think a medicine is making me ill

1. If it is serious (difficulty breathing, swelling of the face or throat, fainting): call 15.
2. Otherwise, talk to a doctor or a pharmacist the same day. Pharmacies have a green cross. At night and on Sundays, call 3237 (in French) to find the pharmacy on duty [to confirm].
3. Do not stop or change a treatment without talking to a doctor or a pharmacist.

### Example: a dry cough with a blood-pressure medicine

Some blood-pressure medicines (ACE inhibitors, whose names end in *-pril*, such as ramipril or perindopril) can cause a dry, tickly cough that does not go away. It affects up to 1 person in 10 taking ramipril. Do not stop the medicine on your own: see your doctor, who can switch you to another medicine. You can also report the cough as a side effect (see [Reporting a side effect](#reporting-a-side-effect)).

## Reporting a side effect

Anyone can report a suspected side effect of a medicine in France, including patients and relatives.

1. Go to the French reporting portal, [signalement.social-sante.gouv.fr](https://signalement.social-sante.gouv.fr). It is in French only.
2. Have ready: the name of the medicine (as on the box), the dates you took it, what happened and when, your age, and your other medicines.
3. A pharmacist or doctor can help you fill it in, or report it for you.

The French page [[Déclarer un effet indésirable]{lang="fr"}](../../declarer.qmd) explains the same steps in more detail.

Your report goes to the regional pharmacovigilance centre: Caen for Calvados, Manche and Orne; Rouen for Eure and Seine-Maritime. It is recorded without your name in the national database. Living elsewhere in France? [Find your regional centre](../../crpv/trouver-mon-crpv.qmd) by typing your postal code (the page is in French).
